chapter_title: The Chapter of the Name of the Fathers
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

** ¶3. ** The Divine Love itself, which is the first self -subsisting reality from which all things of life proceed, is r ightly understood as the Origin of all full ness. Its infinite nature is the ground of all being in which it dwells, subs isting within itself alone . The in most Divine Wisdom that proceeds from it encompasses and perv ades every celest ial good in its abundance , every angelic intelligence, and every state of heav enly reception — and this Wisdom gov erns all that exists beneath it .

**¶4.** The Divine as it actively proceeds to redeem and transform is also recognized as a source of spiritual life. Its full ness is the containing form of living love — a vessel of doctrine shaped entirely from celest ial aff ection — in which it dwells and through which it operates , being wholly present within its own proce eding.

**¶5.** The Divine Truth made radi antly manifest is likewise recognized as a gener ative origin of life . Its full ness is the containing form of living truth — a vessel of doctrine composed of regener ating spiritual tru ths — in which it dwells and from which it acts , being wholly established within its own proceeding.

---

*Note on the structure : * The three figures correspond to a single Divine source app rehended in three distinct modes of proce eding — as Love itself dwelling in its own infinite ground ( ¶3), as Love proceeding actively in the will , carried within aff ection (¶4, fire ), and as Truth proceeding manifestly in the understanding , carried within doctrine (¶5, water). The repeated word "father" signals that each mode is genu inely gener ative: each gives spiritual life, though from a different interior principle .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: Now, the Father, who is the first established thing, shall be called 'the Father of Greatness'. His greatness is the great earth where he lives, he being established in it [alone, and from him there comes forth] the essence of the light that swathes all the rich gods and the angels and the dwellings [of all the aeons. And it] is set over it.
Furthermore, they shall call the Third Ambassador 'father'. His greatness is the light ship of living fire wherein he lives, he being established in it.
Once again, Jesus the Splendour shall himself also be called 'father'. His greatness is the ship of living waters where he lives, he being established in it.
